shared_elements: framing border band running along the edge of the field
justification: The only correspondence is the wholly generic device of a patterned band framing the edge of the field (a rope-like/rectilinear border in A, a rosette band in B). A depicts no figures at all, only schematic incised rectilinear panelling, while B shows a naturalistic modelled procession of human figures in profile leading horned rams — utterly different subject matter and carving conventions.
